scope.roster: stable descending gate; m0 is .001-rounded retained count, m1 is .01-rounded retained count; a=order[:m1], c=order[m1:m0]; order[m0:] stays omitted

basis.rule: Q=qr(C[c,order[:m0]] @ Omega[:m0,:]) reduced QR in float64, cast float32; one pass, no power iteration
basis.fallback: If m1==m0 use parent directly; if nonfinite or numerical rank deficient, retain complete original .001 route; no retuned rank

identity.covariance: Wa.T Caa Wa + delta = W0.T P C00 P W0, P=diag(Ia,Q Q.T)
identity.psd: P C00 P is PSD whenever C00 is PSD; no eigenvalue clipping; current tiny nonPSD residual is not repaired
identity.full_rank: Q square orthogonal on c exactly restores the current .001 covariance in real arithmetic

star_evidence.description: Calls _ss_factors(w.T,(w.T)^2,A32) before roster-specific covariance gathering; full-row STAR factors stay identical.

historical_evidence.description: Old floor .01 best-rank32 on all omitted rows reached late variance error of similar scale as .001 cut. Not current-native accuracy and not the attainable fixed range.

required_gates: Actual total cost saving >=.5% before implementation
No model or capture until root numerical grant
Tiny symmetric cross+self identity and all-original-input immutability
Current source call-chain and C/C32 coherence
